constraint.statement: The installed command route did not expose OutputReader for existing host receipts.

requirements.requirement: Inspect an existing host receipt with hash-bound raw output and an authoritative host result.
evidence: Five tests passed: known count, irregular output, changed raw bytes, foreign receipt, and unavailable local model cases.

requirements.requirement: Allow an explicit local small-model observation on irregular output without changing host evidence.
evidence: Injected model answer cited an exact line; forged success and invented lines were rejected; oversized logs withheld the model request and kept verified host evidence.

requirements.requirement: Route the new output command through the local-codex launcher.
evidence: Nineteen CLI and receipt tests passed; the launcher output help path reached Mavis without loading a model.

requirements.requirement: Keep receipt schema and objective verification intact.
evidence: All 255 Mavis source tests passed; architecture, syntax, and whitespace checks passed. The launcher route addition passed its focused test afterward.

uncertainty: No installed Mavis package or live local model transport was tested in this isolated source checkout.
